title: Your rules file stays yours
description: The antipattern-warning SessionStart hook wrote its built-in list over .claude/rules/antipatterns.md in the project whenever the user-global copy was not byte-identical, so a tracked project policy was lost on every session and pull-based deploy checkouts came back dirty (#4375). It now seeds only an absent file, never overwrites an existing one, and ORK_NO_RULE_SEED=1 turns seeding off. Pick a machine state and compare what the hook does before and after.
